notes.title: UPDATE | VERSION 1.0.5
notes.notes:
Hello Players! 👋

Another dose of fixes, for our dear players! 💕

Changelogs:


 Fixed saving of room prices
 Workers no longer get stuck when trying to climb stairs 2
 Pets no longer pass through the gate 2 when it's closed
 Employees no longer have problems taking pets on a leash
 Service workers no longer stand still when they cannot reach pets
 


Thank you for being with us! 🤝


Pets Hotel Team 🐶

notes.title: UPDATE | VERSION 1.0.4
notes.notes:
Hello Players! 👋

 We continue to develop and make improvements to our game! We are not stopping! 🤯

Thank you for being with us! 🤝

Version 1.0.4 changelogs:


 Improved employee rotation (they no longer get blocked by walls/furniture)
 Fixed the issue of employees spinning in circles with their pets
 Employees no longer go to animals that are being serviced by the Groomer/Masseuse
 Employees no longer get blocked while performing grooming/massage actions
 Added the ability to assign two employees to one station
 Fixed  incorrectly refreshing of employee work hours in the manager's station



Pets Hotel Team 🐶

notes.title: UPDATE | VERSION 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Hello Players! 👋

Thank you for being with us all week, we are not slowing down and we have another update for you! 🥳

We keep track of your opinions and collect feedback, - we write down all ideas and implement what is possible right away, the rest we have saved and we will definitely not forget about them.

Thank you for being with us! 🤝

Version 1.0.3 changelogs:
 The display of employee level on the manager's computer has been fixed.
 Employee's money is now correctly deducted from our account after skipping a day.
 Buying advertising has been improved.
 An issue has been fixed where a player had the opportunity to earn double for one animal.
 The employee icon has been corrected.
 Receptionist can now properly take a dog.
 The issue of the receptionist taking a pet from the groomer or masseuse to hand over to the client has been fixed.
Pets Hotel Team 🐶

notes.title: UPDATE | VERSION 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Here's a list of new changes and fixes 🐶


Version 1.0.2 changelogs:

 - Fixed an issue in some situations where, for some reason, the system cannot play the video in the intro
 - Improved employee navigation system; they should no longer get stuck so often
 - Added icons and names of animals above their owners
 - Translation fixes


Pets Hotel Team 🐶

notes.title: UPDATE | VERSION 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Thank you for the first feedback! 🤩

The first update is now available to downolad! 🛎️

Version 1.0.1 changelogs:
 Phones with pets for whom you haven't built rooms should not ring
 Improved pathfinding for animals; pets should no longer leave the room on their own
 Improved the appearance of arrows in the main menu to make them more noticeable
 Moved the empty map to the beginning of the map list
 Added the ability to reset settings using the -resetsettings command, which you enter in the game properties on Steam. Just remember to remove the command afterward.
One again thank you for the feedback!
Pets Hotel Team 🐶

notes.title: NEW RELEASE DATE!
notes.notes:
Dear Players 🤝

ℹ️ We would like to inform you about the postponement of the premiere by 6 days - the new release day is:

April 17th, 2023, at 3 PM CEST

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41091342/c10b99b9f5d2830ba26998ddcf9baa18337aa2cb.png

The game is ready, we only got the first feedback regarding the localization of the game in 13 languages and we need to refine it. Because Easter is about to start, we are not 100% sure that we will be able to deliver translations for the previously planned release date.

We are very sorry for such sudden information, but we want the game to be fully refined and ready before the premiere, it's only 6 days but they will allow us to refine the game to the smallest details.

Thank you for your understanding,
Pets Hotel Team
